description: Ground truth for data/ships/engineering-options.jsonc — which blueprints and experimental effects each module can take. Availability is per module, not per blueprint: `groups` pins the catalogue shape, `modules` that a module resolves to its group, `exclusions` the modules that are the exception to their group (a Multi-cannon cannot take Phasing Sequence; mining tools take no experimental at all), and `blueprintUnion` that a blueprint-level query returns the union across every group offering it.
